sloka: यानि चौषधजालानि तस्मिन् जातानि पर्वते ।विषघ्नान्यपि नागानां न शेकुः शमितुं विषम्॥५-१-२१॥
transliteration: yāni cauṣadhajālāni tasmin jātāni parvate ।viṣaghnānyapi nāgānāṁ na śekuḥ śamituṁ viṣam॥5-1-21॥

translations.english: Even the medicinal herbs grown on the mountain could not neutralize the effect of the poison of snakes.
